camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi QueryOrders --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --OrderType New --PageNum 1 --PageSize 20 --ProductCode rds --CreateTimeEnd '2016-05-23T12:00:00Z' --ProductType rds --CreateTimeStart '2016-05-23T13:00:00Z' --PaymentStatus Paid
description_en: Queries the orders of users or distribution customers. By default, this operation queries orders created within the last hour. To query orders over a longer period, specify the CreateTimeStart and CreateTimeEnd parameters
description_zh: 查询用户或者分销客户订单列表情况。默认查询当前时间最近1小时范围内订单，如需查询更长时间范围的订单数据，请设CreateTimeStart和CreateTimeEnd参数
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-orders --create-time-end 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --order-type New --payment-status Paid --create-time-start 2016-05-23T13:00:00Z --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryOrders

parameters.help_en: The end time of the creation time range. By default, orders created within the last hour are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 创建时间段止（缺省查询当前时间最近1小时内订单），格式：YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，时区： UTC
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:
Subscription: subscription
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值类型：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:
New: new purchase
Renew: renewal
Upgrade: upgrade
TempUpgrade: temporary upgrade
Downgrade: downgrade
Refund: refund
Convert: billing method conversion
ResizeDisk: disk resizing
CompensatoryRenew: compensatory renewal
IncreaseUpgrade: bandwidth upgrade
Exchange: exchange
ChangeOperatingSystem: operating system replacement
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型，取值范围
New 新购
Renew 续费
Upgrade 升级
TempUpgrade 短时升级
Downgrade 降级
Refund 退款
Convert 付费类型转换
ResizeDisk 调整磁盘大小
CompensatoryRenew 补偿续费
IncreaseUpgrade 带宽升级
Exchange 换购
ChangeOperatingSystem 更换操作系统
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The payment status. For non-refund orders, valid values:
Unpaid: unpaid
Paid: paid
Cancelled: canceled

For refund orders, this parameter can be set to NULL
parameters.help_zh:
支付状态。非退款订单，取值范围：
Unpaid：未支付。
Paid：已支付。
Cancelled：已作废。

对于退款订单可置NULL
parameters.name: payment_status
